name: CAP_CHOWN
description: Override file/group ownership restrictions

name: CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE
description: Bypass file read/write/execute permission checks

name: CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH
description: Bypass file read and directory read/execute permission checks

name: CAP_FOWNER
description: Bypass permission checks that normally require matching file owner UID

name: CAP_FSETID
description: Don't clear set-user/group-ID bits when a file is modified

name: CAP_KILL
description: Bypass permission checks for sending signals

name: CAP_SETGID
description: Manipulate process GIDs and set forged GIDs on socket credentials

name: CAP_SETUID
description: Manipulate process UIDs and set forged UIDs on socket credentials

name: CAP_SETPCAP
description: Grant/remove capabilities to/from other processes

name: CAP_LINUX_IMMUTABLE
description: Set the FS_APPEND_FL and FS_IMMUTABLE_FL i-node flags

name: CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
description: Bind a socket to privileged ports (< 1024)

name: CAP_NET_BROADCAST
description: Make socket broadcasts and listen to multicast

name: CAP_NET_ADMIN
description: Perform network administration: interfaces, routing tables, firewall rules

name: CAP_NET_RAW
description: Use RAW and PACKET sockets

name: CAP_IPC_LOCK
description: Lock memory (mlock/mlockall/mmap/shmctl)

name: CAP_SYS_MODULE
description: Load and unload kernel modules

name: CAP_SYS_RAWIO
description: Perform I/O port operations; access /dev/mem, /dev/kmem, raw disk devices

name: CAP_SYS_CHROOT
description: Use chroot()

name: CAP_SYS_PTRACE
description: Trace arbitrary processes using ptrace()

name: CAP_SYS_ADMIN
description: Broad system administration operations (the most powerful, most abused capability)

name: CAP_SYS_BOOT
description: Reboot the system, or enable/disable reboot via ctrl-alt-del

name: CAP_SYS_TIME
description: Set the system clock and real-time (hardware) clock

name: CAP_AUDIT_WRITE
description: Write records to the kernel audit log

name: CAP_AUDIT_CONTROL
description: Enable/disable auditing, change audit filter rules

name: CAP_SETFCAP
description: Set file capabilities

name: CAP_SYSLOG
description: Perform privileged operations on the kernel syslog (dmesg)

name: CAP_AUDIT_READ
description: Read the audit log via a multicast netlink socket
